tool.name: Groovitron – Music
tool.description: Create music with the connected providers, play it and edit it with ffmpeg.
tool.long_description: Creates tracks with the music providers connected in OmniWrench (Gemini Lyria, ElevenLabs, MiniMax, Stability, Mureka, fal.ai, Replicate and more), with or without lyrics. Tracks are played inside OmniWrench on the current default audio device and can be trimmed or converted to MP3 with ffmpeg. On Windows OmniWrench downloads ffmpeg on request (once for Groovitron and Vidcomic).
img.need_prompt: Please describe what the image should show first.
ffmpeg.missing: {kind} needs ffmpeg (thumbnails, trimming, converting, adding music). ffmpeg is a free program (LGPL/GPL) and is not bundled.
ffmpeg.linux:

{cmd}
ffmpeg.download_q:
Download ffmpeg (Windows, 64-bit, GPL build) and store it in the shared AI folder of OmniWrench? Groovitron and Vidcomic use the same copy.

Source: {url}
music.no_bot: No provider for music is connected yet. Music can be created with e.g. Google Gemini (Lyria), ElevenLabs, MiniMax, Stability AI, Mureka, fal.ai and Replicate. Set up connections under Settings > AI assistants.
music.prompt_hint: Style, mood, instruments, tempo … e.g. "Calm lo-fi beat for the hotline hold music, 80 BPM"
music.cost_hint: Each track may cost money at the provider. Description and lyrics are sent to the provider without pseudonymization; music is stored unencrypted in the music folder of the AI data storage.
